title: Send a message
summary: Queues one email. Relay returns as soon as the message is stored, not when it is delivered.

fields.name: stream
fields.description: One of transactional, tracked or marketing.

fields.name: from
fields.description: A verified sender. When omitted, the app's default sender for the stream is used.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: At least one character, with no line breaks.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The plain-text body. On the marketing stream, both bodies need the {{unsubscribe_url}} merge token.

fields.name: event
fields.description: A label you choose, such as order_confirmation.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: A repeat with the same key returns the first message with duplicate set to true.

fields.name: fromName
fields.description: Display name, up to 100 characters, with no line breaks.

fields.name: attachments
fields.description: Up to 3 objects with filename, contentType and base64 content. Each decodes to at most 5 MB.

responseNote: status is queued, sent, failed or suppressed. The body is not wrapped in data.

errors.when: The body is not valid JSON or fails validation.
from is omitted and the app has no default sender for the stream.
A marketing message lacks {{unsubscribe_url}} in html or text.
from is not a verified sender.
The monthly send quota is used up.

title: Get a message
summary: Returns one message of your app, including its status and counters.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: The messageId returned by a send.

responseNote: The body is the stored message and is not wrapped in data. It carries further delivery fields beyond the ones shown. Times are epoch milliseconds.

errors.when: The message does not exist or belongs to another app.
